findings.why_exploitable: Any app on the device can open or call this component directly with crafted intents or queries, bypassing the app's own flow.
findings.fix: Set android:exported="true" unless other apps need it; otherwise protect it with a signature-level android:permission.

findings.evidence: The provider TheftOverwriteProvider exported="true" without permission
findings.why_exploitable: Any app can query or modify this provider.
findings.fix: Set android:exported="false" unless other apps need it; otherwise protect it with a signature-level android:permission.

findings.why_exploitable: The check is bypassable (for example with a signed APK or the device is rooted)
findings.fix: Remove the check or split it to be package-specific.

findings.evidence: processDeeplink checks for logout, login and grant_uri_permissions paths and launches the corresponding activities with an intent
findings.why_exploitable: Any app on the device can open the app's deeplink URLs and drive its flow with crafted links.
findings.fix: Parse the deep link, open only allowlisted URLs and require explicit user confirmation for other origins.

findings.why_exploitable: The login button is clicked without checking the email or password.
findings.fix: Add a check for empty fields and require both before proceeding.

findings.why_exploitable: Any installed app can register for this action and receive the credentials.
findings.fix: Use an explicit intent (setPackage(getPackageName()) or setComponent), a signature permission on sendBroadcast, or an in-process callback.

findings.why_exploitable: JavaScript in a file:// page can read other local files (and with universal access, any origin), so a loaded HTML file can steal app data.
findings.fix: Load only allowlisted https origins, and keep JavaScript and file access disabled unless required.

findings.why_exploitable: Anyone can unpack the APK and read BASE_URL; the same value ships to every install and cannot be rotated without an update.
findings.fix: Remove the secret from the app; keep it on the server and issue short-lived, per-user tokens.

findings.evidence: uses Gson to read and write non-default Serializable classes
findings.why_exploitable: Gson does not serialize or deserialize methods, so the data is sent as its raw bytes, readable from the APK.
findings.fix: Use a type-specific parcelable (or write it in plain JSON) and read it with readValue/readString/readInt etc.

findings.why_exploitable: A calling app controls part of the SQL, so it can read rows or tables beyond loginData (for example with UNION SELECT or a subquery in the selection).
findings.fix: Use parameterized selections with selectionArgs, a fixed projection map, qb.setStrict(true) and setStrictColumns, and require a permission on the provider.

findings.evidence: caller projection, selection and sortOrder passed to query without setStrict or a projection map
findings.why_exploitable: A calling app controls part of the SQL, so it can read rows or tables beyond the ones selected (for example with UNION SELECT or a subquery in the selection).
findings.fix: Use parameterized selections with selectionArgs, a fixed projection map, qb.setStrict(true) and setStrictColumns, and require a permission on the provider.

findings.why_exploitable: Anyone can unpack the APK and read KEY; the same value ships to every install and cannot be rotated without an update.
findings.fix: Remove the secret from the app; keep it on the server and issue short-lived, per-user tokens.

findings.evidence: passwords stored as plaintext in the default Java Serializable format
findings.why_exploitable: Sensitive data is stored where other apps, backups or anyone with device access can read it.
findings.fix: Avoid storing it, or encrypt it with a Keystore-backed key (EncryptedSharedPreferences/EncryptedFile) in internal storage.

findings.why_exploitable: World-accessible files in the app sandbox can be read or changed by every other app on older Android versions.
findings.fix: Use MODE_PRIVATE; share data with other apps only through a FileProvider with explicit grants.
